rectangleorder = 7  # 8th rectangle corresponds to rectangleorder=7 (zero-indexed)

table_data = table_extractor.data

column_widths = [40] * num_cols  # uniform column width of 40 for each column

    pagenumber=pagenumber,
    clip=argument["clip"],
    data=table_data,
    arrange=arrange,
    fontsize=argument["fontsize"],

)
